Ph.D. in Geology
Our department offers the opportunity to learn from some of the most accomplished faculty and to work on some of the most exciting and significant projects in Earth Science. Alumni of our graduate program have gone on to prestigious positions in research science, industry, and academia.
The PhD in Geology is flexible and can be focused on any of the broad disciplinary research areas of our faculty, including:
Organic Geochemistry and Biogeochemistry
Earth System History and Paleoclimatology
Paleoceanography and Micropaleontology
Environmental Informatics
Geochemistry of the Earth's Interior
Metamorphic Petrology and Thermochemistry
Solid-Earth Geophysics
Program Outcome
Students who successfully complete this program will be able to demonstrate:
Conceive of, design, and conduct independent research in a subfield of the geosciences.
Demonstrate the creation of new knowledge through successful execution and defense of the PhD research project.
